R/ [VICTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAES]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Magnentius or Decentius (351-353), Two Victories issue of 351-353, small module copy, Reece period 18; chipped. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: probably [---]ENTIVS AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories holding up shield inscribed VOT /V/MVLT/X. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAES].
